_note: Which version of a person/choir to keep (registry.mjs). Default: the most recent page. "fullest" = the longest biography (most recent of equally long ones); or name a page, e.g. "festivals/2025" (pages: festivals/<year>, masterclasses/<year>, competitions/<slug>; ids: app/content/people.ts and choirs.ts). Then run npm run legacy:import. 2026-10-11: the client chose the fuller versions where the 2026 page had shortened them.
